2610.06614.title: FREA: A Multi-Source Expert Benchmark for Reaction Feasibility Verification
2610.06614.paper_summary: As generative models and AI agents propose chemical reactions at a scale beyond expert review, feasibility verifiers decide which proposals enter synthesis planning. But do their decisions agree with chemists across different kinds of candidates? We introduce FREA, a benchmark of 751 reactions labeled by expert chemists under an explicit feasibility criterion, drawn from retrosynthesis model proposals, zero-yield experimental records, edits by large language models (LLMs), and five negative candidate generation methods. Our evaluation finds that no verifier leads across all sources: LLMs given only the criterion are competitive with dedicated verifiers, while forward models perform best on retrosynthesis proposals but reject most feasible edits of recorded reactions at the evaluated operating points. Looking beyond aggregate scores, both forward models perform below chance when separating infeasible alternative disconnections from feasible generated candidates. To study whether negative supervision addresses these weaknesses, we also release a corpus of over 14 million recorded reactions and generated negative candidates. In matched training comparisons, adding a mixture of generated negatives to forward training raises mean AUROC across sources, but these gains do not extend to retrosynthesis proposals. Varying the generation method further shows that the largest gain on generated candidates coincides with worse proposal screening. These findings motivate evaluating verifiers against experts across sources and designing negatives for transfer to model proposals.
2610.06614.paper_summary_zh: 生成模型和人工智慧代理在超出專家審查的範圍內提出化學反應，可行性驗證者決定哪些提案進入合成規劃。<lb/>但他們的決策是否與不同類型候選者的化學家達成一致？<lb/>我們介紹了FREA，一個包含751個反應的基準，這些反應由專家化學家根據明確的可行性標準標記，這些反應來源於逆合成模型提案、零產量實驗記錄、大型語言模型（LLMs）的編輯，以及五種負候選生成方法。<lb/>我們的評估發現，沒有任何驗證者在所有來源中領先：僅根據標準的LLMs與專門的驗證者競爭，而前向模型在逆合成提案中表現最佳，但在評估的操作點上拒絕了大多數可行的記錄反應編輯。<lb/>超越總體得分，兩種前向模型在將不可行的替代斷裂與可行生成候選者分開時的表現低於隨機機會。<lb/>為了研究負監督是否能解決這些弱點，我們還發布了一個包含超過1400萬個記錄反應和生成的負候選者的語料庫。<lb/>在匹配訓練比較中，將生成的負樣本混合添加到前向訓練中，提高了各來源的平均AUROC，但這些增益並未擴展到逆合成提案。<lb/>改變生成方法進一步顯示，對生成候選者的最大增益與較差的提案篩選同時出現。<lb/>這些發現促使我們在各來源中評估驗證者與專家的表現，並設計負樣本以轉移到模型提案中。
